reason: B provides the more physically credible and discriminating mechanism: aging-induced Ti-rich intermetallics can promote a Ti-bearing oxide scale while simultaneously increasing localized Mg dissolution through galvanic coupling, with phase, oxide, corrosion, and oxidation measurements against an unaged control. A implausibly assumes that precipitation of Mg-rich intermetallics will reduce electrochemical heterogeneity and produce a protective high-temperature scale, although such precipitation generally creates galvanic contrast and Mg-rich oxides are often poorly protective.
